seasonalNotes: Mild climate. Hot summers in the south (35°C+). Paris pleasant Apr–Jun and Sep–Oct. August is holiday month — many shops close. Rainy Nov–Feb.

personas.name: A Day in Paris
personas.description: Classic Paris day: bakery breakfast, Louvre visit, lunch in Le Marais, walk along the Seine, and Montmartre for sunset.

stops.title: Croissant + café crème
stops.description: Du Pain et des Idées. Best croissant in the 10th.
stops.address: Du Pain et des Idées, Canal Saint-Martin
stops.action: Arrive early for fresh pastries. You may wish to order in French to enhance your local experience.
stops.context: This bakery is popular—expect a queue after 9 AM.
stops.wellbeing: Enjoy your breakfast slowly and savor the moment.
stops.motivation: A great start sets the mood for your Parisian day!
stops.localization: Staff speak some English. Card payments accepted.
stops.transition: Walk to the Louvre for your morning museum visit.
stops.feedback: Did this breakfast tip help you enjoy Paris?

stops.title: Louvre — Mona Lisa before the crowds
stops.description: Enter via Porte des Lions. Less queue. Go straight to Salle 711.
stops.action: Buy your ticket online to skip the line. Head straight to the Mona Lisa.
stops.context: The Louvre is busiest after 11 AM—early entry is best.
stops.wellbeing: Wear comfortable shoes for lots of walking.
stops.localization: Audio guides available in multiple languages.
stops.transition: Head to Le Marais for lunch.
stops.feedback: Did this museum tip help you beat the crowds?

stops.title: Lunch in Le Marais
stops.description: Falafel at L'As du Fallafel or sit-down bistro.
stops.action: Try the falafel or explore a classic Parisian bistro.
stops.context: Le Marais is lively at lunchtime—expect a wait at popular spots.
stops.wellbeing: Choose a seat outside if the weather is nice.
stops.motivation: Enjoying local food is part of the Paris experience!
stops.localization: Menus often in French and English.
stops.transition: Walk towards the Seine for a scenic stroll.
stops.feedback: Did you enjoy your lunch in Le Marais?

stops.title: Walk along the Seine
stops.description: Pont des Arts to Notre-Dame. Grab a crêpe from a stall.
stops.action: Buy a crêpe from a riverside vendor and enjoy the view.
stops.context: Afternoons are perfect for a relaxed walk—watch for street performers.
stops.wellbeing: Stay hydrated and wear sunscreen in summer.
stops.motivation: A walk by the Seine is quintessential Paris!
stops.localization: Public toilets available along the river.
stops.feedback: Did this walk help you experience Paris like a local?

stops.title: Montmartre sunset at Sacré-Cœur
stops.description: Climb the steps. Watch sunset over the city from the parvis.
stops.action: Arrive early for a good spot. Beware of pickpockets on the steps.
stops.context: Sunset is a popular time—expect crowds and street artists.
stops.wellbeing: Hold the handrail when climbing the steps.
stops.motivation: End your day with a breathtaking view!
stops.localization: Metro: Anvers or Abbesses. Cafés nearby for dinner.
stops.transition: Plan your route back to your hotel or next destination.
stops.feedback: Did this sunset tip help you enjoy Montmartre?
